step3_motion_estimators.verdict: IMAGE REGISTRATION LOSES. Global phase correlation (2.801 um) and 4x4x4 block deformable registration (2.167 um) are both WORSE THAN ASSUMING ZERO MOTION (1.817 um); the existing graph-derived kNN flow (1.329 um) beats both by ~2x. On the very state phase correlation defines (global_translation) its residual is 19.2 um against zero-motion's 8.83 um - it is actively harmful as a vector estimate while remaining a valid FLAG.
step3_motion_estimators.state_conditioning_gain: E5 = existing knn16 scaled by the observed interval multiplier (L+1) improves post_frozen_gap reach<=6um from 0.8776 to 0.9005 and median residual 2.482 -> 2.256 um; pooled reach<=6um 0.9825 -> 0.9837. Free, right sign, tiny pooled.
step3_motion_estimators.block_flow_basis: sampled 26 crops = 22.93% of pooled edge mass (12 heaviest 6bba, 8 heaviest 44b6, 6 most-frozen); all other estimators are corpus-complete

step4_policy_and_ceiling.policy: P-ACQ: condition association on an OBSERVABLE frame-pair state computed from raw pixels only. (a) detect exact repeats by hashing the compressed zarr chunk (one chunk == one frame, zero decode); (b) on a frozen pair force zero-displacement association; (c) on the pair following a frozen run of length L, treat the effective interval as L+1 and scale the motion prior and the enumeration cap accordingly; (d) on a global_translation / deformation pair, flag the pair as high-displacement. No crop identifier, no family identifier, no ground truth enters at any point.
step4_policy_and_ceiling.why_this_is_not_family_routing: the state is a function of the pixel content of two consecutive volumes and is evaluated per pair at test time; the fact that it never fires in 44b6 is an OUTCOME of the data, not an input to the rule

step4_policy_and_ceiling.cross_family_verdict: The full policy is positive on both families (+0.003875 / +0.022925), so it cannot invert. But 85% of its ceiling comes from two states that have ZERO incidence in 44b6, where the policy is a literal no-op - transfer there is VACUOUS, not demonstrated. Only P_xfam (global_translation + deformation + intensity_discontinuity) is genuinely bilateral, and it is nearly balanced: +0.003637 on 44b6 vs +0.003349 on 6bba. That is the transferable core, and it is worth +0.0034 pooled as a ceiling.

deployable_status.reason: the two state-sensitive stages are assoc_enum_beyond_cap and assoc_enum_relaxed_starved. Widening or re-centring the enumeration gate cannot be replayed exactly from artifacts/kaggle/e0c_cache/candidates: that cache only contains pairs already inside E0c's 10.0 um relaxed gate, and edge_prob is nonzero out to 9.88 um, so the transformer's probabilities for the newly admitted pairs are unknown and cannot be assumed 0. An exact deployable number requires re-running inference, i.e. GPU.
deployable_status.the_specific_mechanism_found: src/biotrack/wrapper.py::motion_relink_edges gates on the RAW source-target distance (`if raw > gate_um: continue`) while its COST uses the motion-predicted distance. On a frame-pair whose effective interval is doubled, or which carries an abrupt global displacement, the true partner is excluded by the raw gate before the cost is ever evaluated. The state-conditioned repair is to gate on the FLOW-COMPENSATED residual at the same radius rather than to widen the radius - which admits no extra candidates and therefore does not repeat branch A's failure (global widening to 10 um cost -0.1596 / -0.1496).
deployable_status.supporting_measurement: under the existing knn16 flow the reach<=6um of true continuations rises from 0.9769 (raw gate) to 0.9908 on ordinary pairs, and from 0.8029 to 0.8776 on post_frozen_gap pairs; scaling by the interval multiplier takes post_frozen_gap to 0.9005

new_environment_traps_found.trap_18_scorer_is_input_row_order_depend: The exact patched scorer's edge classification depends on the ORDER of the edge rows handed to submission_to_graphs. On 6bba_a90a0b9c, insertion order gives edge_tp 828 / fp 274 / fn 284 while set order gives 829 / 273 / 283. There are no duplicate edges; the out-degree>2 cap and the merge-dedup both keep the lowest edge id, so insertion order decides. Corpus effect: DEN 151615 vs 151614, pooled 0.6653932886896151 vs 0.6654043056779473, |d| = 1.10e-05. CANONICAL is insertion order. Any replay that rebuilds an edge list must use a list plus a seen-set, never a bare set comprehension, or it silently anchors to the wrong baseline.
new_environment_traps_found.trap_19_zarr_chunk_equals_frame: train crops are zarr v3, chunk_shape (1,64,256,256), storage_transformers []. One frame is exactly one chunk file, and the blosc/zstd codec is deterministic, so raw-volume identity is equivalent to compressed-byte identity. A pure os.stat size prefilter over 19,900 files followed by sha256 on the 1,800 size collisions settles exact duplication over the whole corpus in 110 s instead of 160 GB of decoding.
new_environment_traps_found.trap_20_gt_node_id_encoding_differs_by_f: 44b6 GT geffs encode node_id = (t + crop_offset)*1e9 + track_id with a per-crop offset; 6bba encodes (t+1)*1e6 + track_id. A single decode rule silently produces nonsense frame indices on one family. Build node_id -> t from the geff, never from an arithmetic assumption.
new_environment_traps_found.trap_21_polars_schema_inference_drops_a_: pl.DataFrame(list_of_dicts) infers the schema from the leading rows. A field that is absent (or None) in the first crops processed is dropped or typed Null and then fails on append. Pass an explicit schema for any per-row accumulation whose keys are conditionally populated.

primitive_matrix_row.deployable_exact_pooled_delta: NOT MEASURED - requires GPU re-inference; the enumerated-candidate cache cannot answer it
primitive_matrix_row.family_transfer: full policy positive on both (+0.0039 / +0.0229) but VACUOUS on 44b6 for 85% of the ceiling; only the +0.0034 global_translation/deformation/intensity subset is genuinely bilateral (+0.003637 / +0.003349)
primitive_matrix_row.decision: GATES PASS. Promote the acquisition-state flag as a cheap, GT-free, always-on primitive. Do NOT promote image registration as a motion estimator - it is measurably worse than assuming zero motion.
primitive_matrix_row.next_integration_dependency: one GPU inference pass with the motion-relink gate applied to the FLOW-COMPENSATED residual instead of the raw distance, state-conditioned on (L+1); everything else needed is already measured and cached
